grammatica.evidence: Public essay English: multi-clause setups then short correctives ('This is wrong.'); 'by inertia, by A/B tests, by legacy'; no coinages; register fully within general web literacy.

dialectica.evidence: Chain is made not derived: unnoticed→two strengths→disproportionate moral weight→not no-defaults→revealed-interest paternalism→who-loses test→living hypothesis→combo explosion→crypto-params as governance failure.

rhetorica.evidence: Ordered frames: blank page/font → retirement 30/90 → newsletter/tax → telemetry/ballots/organs → form abandonment → crypto hashes; policy examples chosen from large visible option space.

arithmetica.evidence: Atoms mix public-retrievable (opt-in ~30% vs opt-out ~90%; organ donation; choice as scarce resource) with essay-specific claims (Tuesday meeting; living hypothesis; combo instrumentation); value in which claims held.

geometria.evidence: Unsectioned continuous prose, ~11 paragraphs, no heads/lists/tables; linear thesis-to-closing column—standard public essay page shape.

musica.evidence: Local cadence: paragraph-final maxims ('the choices no one notices making'); tricola ('paralysis, or avoidance, or a choice...'); stress on short pivots after long setup clauses.

astronomia.evidence: Arc: define+claim → two mechanisms → raise moral stakes → block 'no defaults' → design criterion → heterogeneity → iterate → interactions → measure → invisible labor/incentives → crypto/governance close.

notes: Telos is claim-delivery to policy readers; dialectica carries the original work—rhetorica/astronomia are selection of known essay moves around public nudge facts.
